sampling: uniform sources without replacement within each batch; then uniform query within source; equal 12800 sampled examples and 800 updates per arm
label_policy: half-open actual source-PTS foreground; shortest containing GT if overlap; human 2-second saliency cells mapped by floor(source_pts/2)
secondary_decoder: unchanged E4 curve decoder on learned foreground probabilities, NMS.9/top5; report all, no model or decoder selection
primary: 256/large dense mAP minus same-visual-feature cap32 E4; conditional internal study only
factorial: report every data effect, capacity effect, and data-by-capacity interaction, all fixed final-step models
stop_rule: four fixed arms; validation queries only for frozen feature preparation, no validation labels enter training and no validation metrics until all final checkpoints saved; no width/depth/steps/seed/decoder search; resume interrupted optimizer state exactly, never refit completed arms
scope: official UniVTG network and five losses, token text and learned dense boundaries; CLIP-only 1fps source-PTS adaptation, no external locator weights, no SlowFast, no large PT, no full-paper reproduction; only 63/254 train sources, not full QVHL; no independent generalization claim
